unique_cohort_processes.meaning: The 336 A/A records and 28 A/A primes are reused, not run three times. Separate exploratory, debugger, compiler-identity and native test processes are excluded from these cohort totals.

accepted_observation_notes: About 67.8 percent lower cold wall/CPU geometric aggregate across seven literal cases; individual cold median gains span 11.99 to 90.13 percent. This is not a 68 percent gain for every case.
Primary main bodies are 204 to 205 bytes versus 5521 to 360594 bytes. These code-body counts exclude the exact passive UTF16 payload.

Warm hello block1 wall median/mean rises 14.38/28.45 percent and CPU 6.68/9.32 percent; build integer block1 wall rises 5.62/5.04 percent; build join4096 block0 CPU rises 3.56/5.89 percent. None repeats its complete veto in both blocks.

Warm mixed1024 block0 means rise about 7.1 percent despite slightly lower medians. The largest positive current RSS median shift is 0.25MiB for cold retained-object block0; its mean shifts down 0.10MiB.

The 5.211-second/761.36MiB large-literal child belongs to the rejected fixed-array candidate, not the accepted FP47 baseline. The final joint-admission child is about 0.339 seconds/140.594MiB for all three lengths together; no per-size attribution.

diagnostics.mapping_scope: Four intrusive GDB exit_group captures and two warm primes. Current mappings after teardown, not peak-phase attribution. The captured increase is resident main-ELF code, with equal anonymous/heap RSS at those stops.
